metric: generated-span micro 1s segment F1, NOT mpAUC

clip.note: Audio-class/query presence; repeated events collapsed; only supplied queries evaluated.
clip.map_note: Macro average of sklearn non-interpolated AP per class with positive GT; scores are binary 0/1 generated presence, not native confidence. No evaluable mAP for positive-only grounding queries. All equal-score predictions are tied, no arbitrary tie ordering.

coverage.policy: Exclude incomplete audio entirely, including its successful windows; not a full-test-set score.
